subject: Temporal contract stress: exercise change/time/decision fabrics with Runpod retirement divergence

body.fixture: Runpod v1 retirement evidence currently contains two explicit bounds: body says v1 returns 410 Gone on 2026-11-15 while subject says retirement 2026-12-01. Current conservative operational bound is the earlier 2026-11-15 until resolved.
required_actions: Represent both observations as immutable EvidenceGraph occurrences with BonfyreTime/time-fabric coordinates; preserve the contradiction as TraceDivergence rather than overwriting one date.
Create a decision/contract artifact that chooses the conservative migration deadline and binds the exact evidence addresses, decision rule, authority scope and validity interval.
Generate downstream WorkGraph obligations for Runpod v2 migration/audit from that decision contract; projections should show why Nov 15 is active without claiming the contradiction resolved.

Run a counterfactual/retraction simulation where later authoritative evidence resolves the deadline to Dec 1. Retract/supersede the decision contract without deleting old evidence; invalidate only dependent factors/work and recompute projections.
Prove historical replay at a time before and after the hypothetical resolution returns the correct then-valid decision.
Use the first-class BonfyreTime/contract/ledger machinery where registered; do not replace it with generic timestamps.
body.acceptance: One temporal proof bundle must show occurrence -> conflicting evidence -> conservative decision -> dependent work -> later retraction -> selective invalidation -> historical replay.
